answer: The lagoon schedule is applied in whisper and canyon publishes each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2511 identities would post 3569 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
